createdFrom.method: Real files: union of the files touched by each card's own commits on any ref (subject starts with the card key; develop syncs and merges excluded). Code files: backend/, frontend/, orchestration-decisions/, runner/, scripts/ without Markdown. Cited files: repository paths and unique file names cited in the source finding text (problem, cause, acceptance criteria) of the playthrough card lists AGT-3885, AGT-3886, AGT-3888. Forecast files: cited files plus files that changed together with a cited file in at least half of its commits between 15 September and 15 November 2026 (at least three commits, commits of more than 40 code files ignored). Keyword areas: IntakeRunner.DetectTaskAreas needles applied to the same source text. Develop sync commits: commits naming the card whose subject records a develop merge, an include of latest develop or a conflict resolution, rewritten copies included.
